0f96a33d296e07a19a786341@montreal-poetry.title: Discussion - Why Music is Genetic
0f96a33d296e07a19a786341@montreal-poetry.venue: Librairie Résonance Bookstore, 40 Beaubien East, Montréal
0f96a33d296e07a19a786341@montreal-poetry.description:
Contributor(s): Bullerdiek, Jörn (Author) , Süßmuth, Christine (Author) , Grönemeyer, Dietrich (Foreword by) , Darwin, Sarah (Foreword by)
We are happy to welcome the author of Why Music is Genetic, Jörn Bullerdiek for a discussion on the subject of genetics and music. 

The presentation will be with live musical examples by Baroque composers John Dowland, Francesca Caccini and Henry Purcell, performed by Julie Comparini (voice) and Seth Demspey (lute). Julie will replace Christine who unfortunately is unable to join us in December. 

Julie Comparini studied cognitive science and linguistics at the University of California-Berkeley and early music singing at the Hochschule für Künste in Bremen, Germany. As a multimedia singer and performer, she builds bridges between genres and disciplines.
www.juliecomparini.com/en/
 
Free admission. Book will be available.
 Biographical Note:Jörn Bullerdiek is a human geneticist currently working as scientific advisor at the Genetic and Immunology Testing Laboratory, Alicante, Spain. He is also a committed supporter of interdisciplinary collaborations, such as the one on which this book is based.
Christine Süßmuth studied Early Music at the University of Arts in Bremen, Germany. As a soloist and ensemble singer, she knows exactly what she is talking about when it comes to musical technique, music history, and the joy of making music.
Do you know why Johann Sebastian Bach was considered light-fingered? Or what you could do with a lock of Mozart's hair if you had it? These questions could lead you to an ancient mystery: Why do humans enjoy producing musical notes, as Darwin put it? Is this ability literally in our DNA, and if so, what is it doing there? The authors sailed dangerously close to the Sirens' Rock and joined Orpheus in meeting the sinister creatures of the underworld. They traced the path of sound waves from their source to the listener's brain and analyzed the genealogy of the Bach family and the song of zebra finches. They visited "Scarborough Fair" to buy parsley, sage, rosemary, and thyme. Eventually, they took the ferry to the "Isle of Capri," referencing Frank Sinatra and the many other singers who have covered that song. Overall, the result is an entertaining and informative analysis of what makes music so fascinating and how this fascination is reflected in our genes from ancient Egypt to the present day.

9777f940c8212553d08b0f4e@montreal-poetry.title: SESSION REWIND - POIRIER IL N'Y A PAS DE SUD...
9777f940c8212553d08b0f4e@montreal-poetry.venue: Librairie Résonance Bookstore, 40 Beaubien East, Montréal
9777f940c8212553d08b0f4e@montreal-poetry.description:
Notez que la session aura lieu le 21 janvier (et non le 19 novembre tel qu'initialement indiqué)
Nous sommes ravis d'accueillir une figure marquante de la musique électronique au Québec lors du 25ème anniversaire de la sortie de son album Il n'y a que le sud...
Figure incontournable de Montréal, Poirier s’est imposé par une approche créative et éclectique de la production électronique. Des atmosphères lo-fi scintillantes de ses débuts aux rythmes entraînants inspirés du soca dans ses projets plus récents, sa signature musicale puise dans une vaste diversité de traditions sonores, affirmant sa place sur la scène internationale.
Avec plus de 25 ans de parcours, le DJ, producteur et auteur-compositeur a construit une discographie importante sur des labels tels que Ninja Tune et Wonderwheel Recordings. Il a également signé plus de 55 remix officiels, son approche recherchée ayant été sollicitée par des artistes comme Gotan Project, Gilles Peterson, Guts, Salif Keita, Nickodemus, João Selva, Flavia Coelho, Popcaan ou Busy Signal, entre autres.
Déroulement de la soirée: 
19h Introduction de l'artiste19h05 Écoute de l'album20h Discussion avec l'artiste
Le vinyle Il n'y a pas de sud ainsi que son plus récent ouvrage Flip the Script Sounds Good seront vendus sur place.
